name: Procreation
overview: Scripture reveals that procreation is a divine mandate established at creation, where God made man and woman in His image and commanded them to be fruitful and multiply, filling the earth (Genesis 1:27-28). This blessing is reaffirmed after the flood, emphasizing the ongoing call to multiply and steward the earth (Genesis 9:1,7). The union of husband and wife is foundational to this purpose, as they become one flesh to fulfill God's design for family and multiplication (Genesis 2:24). Children are portrayed as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, highlighting the sacred value of offspring within God's covenant plan (Psalms 127:3).
